name: What should I prepare before contacting a design-build firm for a new home project?
description: Before contacting a design-build firm, prepare your project scope, preliminary budget, inspiration images, and a list of needs for your new home.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a design-build firm for a new home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a design-build firm, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your project's scope, a preliminary budget, and a collection of inspiration images or ideas for your desired home style. Preparing a list of your family's needs, desired number of rooms, and any specific features you envision can help us understand your vision better. Having a basic understanding of your property's characteristics, like size and potential challenges, is also valuable. This preparation helps us provide a more accurate initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting a design-build firm, prepare your project scope, preliminary budget, inspiration images, and a list of needs for your new home.
